title: finding(components,types): tooltip `content`'s declared `SchemaNode` arm crashes at the read site — `tooltip.tsx` places it raw as a React child (objectui#7759 group B residue)
body:
Residue of objectstack-ai/objectui#7759 **group B**, surfaced by the dev executing objectui#10280 (PR objectui#10292) and confirmed by that PR's isolated contract review. Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`. Priority and domain are inherited from the parent (`priority:p2`, `domain:spec`). Triage may regrade.

## The defect

Both faces accept `TooltipSchema.content` as `string | SchemaNode`: the declaration in `overlay.ts`, and the mirror after PR objectui#10292. But the read site, `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/tooltip.tsx`, places `schema.content` **raw** into `TooltipContent`. Only `children` goes through `renderChildren`. So the declared single-node arm fails at render:

```
SchemaRenderer {type:'tooltip', open:true, trigger:{…}, content:{type:'text', content:'A'}}
→ error boundary: "Component tooltip failed to render / Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, content})"
```

This is the dev's runtime probe, and the contract reviewer confirmed it from the code. Only the string arm actually renders.

## The choice (ruling 5617465269 rule 2: an objectui-own key follows its read site, and the spec does not declare `TooltipSchema`)

- **(i)** Narrow both faces to text, matching the read site. The designer `inputs` already says `type: 'string'`. Rich content keeps using `children`.
- **(ii)** Render `content` through `renderChildren`. This is a renderer feature, and the declaration stays as it is.

Rule 2 points at **(i)** mechanically, since the read site handles text only. (ii) would add a capability.

## Also on this surface (docs only; this card carries them)

- `content/docs/components/overlay/tooltip.mdx` still lists `body?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]`. objectui#6771 retired `body`, and the mirror refuses it by name, so the surviving spelling is `children`.
- `content/docs/components/form/slider.mdx` shows `defaultValue?: number` without the list arm, which PR objectui#10292 declares.
- The open question from ruling 5617221514: `content || children` silently drops `children` when both are authored.

Serial after PR objectui#10292, which touches the same `overlay.zod.ts` region.
